attributes.title: historian_browse
attributes.description: Browse historical paths with native bounded continuation. Patch-specific/ignored Historian parameters are intentionally not exposed.

parameters.name: rootPath
parameters.description: Historical browse root such as a histprov-qualified path; at most 2048 characters.

parameters.name: nameFilters
parameters.description: Optional native name filters; at most 20 non-empty strings of at most 256 characters each.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Whether to browse recursively. Default false.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum results in one page, 1..500. Default 100.

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token returned by a previous historian_browse call; at most 8192 characters.
